Alex W: Heads up—compliance asked for a digest of control owners + open deps for the next milestone. I pushed an updated dep matrix to the docs. Who's owning audit-log backfill and HSM key rotation sign-off?
Priya R: I can own the HSM sign-off (will coordinate with Maria for KMS cert). @Maria G — flagging you as the HSM/keystore SME, any blockers on your side?
Maria G: On HSM side: infra patch to rotate root key is staged. Need dev-sre code review on rollback hooks. Targeting code freeze Wednesday. Current blocker: `keystore-agent` test flakiness on arm builds (timeouts).
Sam K: Audit-log backfill: branch `audit-backfill/2026` has the ingest job and mappings. PR <https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/7891|#7891> — awaiting one more +1 from eng-infra. I can run a sanity job in staging tomorrow if infra confirms capacity.
Alex W: Thanks. Priya/Maria, can you confirm estimated ETA for HSM sign-off? Compliance expects a target window for fieldwork next week.
Priya R: ETA: EOD Thursday for verification assuming infra can unblock the test flakes. If not, we should move sign-off to Monday.
Maria G: Agree. I'll also coordinate a canary backfill with Sam on a single shard Tues morning. Adding a quick runbook snippet here so ops can follow after smoke test:

```bash
# run backfill for shard 42
./ingest-backfill --shard=42 --dry-run
```

I'll paste this into the runbooks repo after the smoke pass.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: staging cluster scale-up completed at 2026-03-03T09:12:08Z — available nodes +4.
Sam K: :thumbsup: I'll kick the staging sanity run tomorrow 10am PT and post results. If all green, I can merge #7891 and plan prod backfill Thu evening (low-traffic window).
Alex W: Perfect. Action items: Sam -> staging sanity + merge PR; Maria -> fix keystore test flakes or open rollback-hooks PR; Priya -> HSM sign-off docs; Alex -> update dep matrix and notify compliance of tentative window. Please update the dep matrix row with explicit 'owner' and 'blocker' columns so compliance can track. Thanks all.
